text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what is this...? Power is welling up 
inside me...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the Three Goddesses are 
cheering me on, telling me to do my best 
as a local idol...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's work even, even harder! Both to 
succeed as a local idol, and for the sake 
of Tomakomai!
